description: For a parent-company lookup, this tool returns the parent company and the employers linked to it, with the GLEIF record that proves each link. For a name lookup, it returns up to 25 parent companies whose name starts with the text given. A link exists only when the employer's name and one worksite address match its GLEIF record.

name.description: Use the start of a parent company's name (3 characters or more).

parent_id.description: Use the parent company's LEI (20 characters) from a /company page.

name: get_parent_company
title: Get parent company
